{{Quote|Pirates inbound! Maintain the defensive perimeter, we need more time for repairs!|The ''Acclamator's'' Captain upon Tyber's arrival|<ref name="FOC />}}
An '''unidentified ''Acclamator''-class assault ship''' was one of the few [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] survivors of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]]. The [[Assault ship/Legends|assault ship]] was left in a damaged state, drifting in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] amongst the wreckage of the Death Star. [[Imperial Tartan cruiser defectors|Four]] [[Tartan-class patrol cruiser|''Tartan''-class corvettes]] were assigned to act as the ''Acclamator's'' vanguard while its crew attempted to repair it.

During the ''Acclamator's'' repairs, [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tyber Zann]] entered the Yavin system in search for a series of [[Data pod|data pods]] left behind in the Death Star wreck. When Tyber's [[Interceptor IV-class frigate|''Interceptor'' IV frigate]] approached the damaged ''Acclamator'', he gave a code phrase to the four ''Tartan'' corvettes to signal them to turn on the ''Acclamator''. Unable to escape and lacking the necessary firepower to repel the traitors, the ''Acclamator'' was destroyed.<ref name="FOC />
